description.zh:
是否自动付费。取值：
- **true**：自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。
<props="china">- **false**：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择**费用** > **费用与成本**，在左侧导航栏，选择**订购订单**>**我的订单**，在**商品订单**页签找到目标订单进行支付。</props>
<props="intl">- **false**：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择**费用** > **费用与成本**，在左侧导航栏，单击**订单管理**，在**商品订单**页面找到目标订单进行支付。</props>

默认值为：**true**。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

- **true**: Enables automatic payment. Make sure that your account has a sufficient balance.

<props="china">

- **false**: Disables automatic payment. To pay for the order, log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console. In the upper-right corner of the page, choose **Expenses** > **Expenses and Costs**. In the navigation pane on the left, choose **Subscription Orders** > **My Orders**. On the **Product Orders** tab, find the order and complete the payment.

</props>


<props="intl">

- **false**: Disables automatic payment. To pay for the order, log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console. In the upper-right corner of the page, choose **Expenses** > **Expenses and Costs**. In the navigation pane on the left, click **Order Management**. On the **Product Orders** page, find the order and complete the payment.

</props>


Default value: **true**.

description.zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值说明：
- **true**：开启自动续费。
- **false**：不开启自动续费。

默认值为 **false**
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. Valid values:

- **true**: Enables auto-renewal.

- **false**: Disables auto-renewal.

Default value: **false**
The business information. This is an additional parameter.
The coupon code. The default value is `youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank`.

description.zh:
修改后的磁盘类型，取值：
- **cloud_auto**：ESSD AutoPL 云盘。
description.en:
The disk type after the modification. Valid value:

- **cloud\_auto**: ESSD AutoPL disk.

description.zh:
变配类型，取值：

- **UPGRADE**：升级配置。
- **DOWNGRADE**：降级配置。

> 当实例付费方式为包年包月时，该参数可用。
description.en:
The order type. Valid values:

- **UPGRADE**: Upgrades the instance configuration.

- **DOWNGRADE**: Downgrades the instance configuration.

> This parameter is available only when the instance uses the subscription billing method.

description.zh: 预配置性能（IOPS）。取值范围为 0~50000。
description.en: The provisioned IOPS. Valid values: 0 to 50000.

descriptions.zh:
- 磁盘空间小于40GB，不支持此功能。
- 只支持变配至cloud_auto云盘类型。
- 单个实例两次修改IOPS预配置性能的时间间隔需超过一小时。更多说明，请参见[修改ESSD AutoPL云盘性能配置](~~413275~~)。
descriptions.en:
- This feature is not supported for instances with less than 40 GB of disk space.

- You can change the disk type only to an ESSD AutoPL disk (cloud\_auto).

- The interval between two consecutive modifications to the provisioned input/output operations per second (IOPS) of an instance must be longer than one hour. For more information, see [Modify the performance of an ESSD AutoPL disk](~~413275~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds modify-db-instance-disk-type --db-instance-storage-type cloud_auto --provisioned-iops 1960 --db-instance-id dds-bp1fa5efaa930000 --auto-pay true --business-info '“ActivityId_:_000000000' --coupon-no youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank --extra-param async --auto-renew false --order-type UPGRADE --region cn-hangzhou
